HUGHES: In Cheswold, Del. on June 21, 1957, Sarah E. Hughes, age 81 years. Relatives and friends are invited to attend funeral services from the Immanuel Union Methodist Church, Cheswold, Del. on Tuesday afternoon June 25, at 2 o'clock. Interment at Fork Branch Cemetary. Friends may call at her late residence on Monday evening from 7 until 9 o'clock. Arrangements by the Howard C. Stevenson Funeral Home, Dover, Del.
